source_mode: Finite rigid palm support relocation on licensed source geometry; no mesh, UV, weights or finger-angle edits
requirements: Preserve sealed prior experiments, weapon transform, right hand, left wrist orientation and frozen wrap finger commands
Evaluate exactly 12 prescribed tangential offsets: world X[-20,-10,0,10]mm by Z[-10,0,10]mm; no iterative search
Choose actual parallel underside triangles within120mm of the old palm support in the tangential plane; rigid palm vertex must have an opposing palmar face
Solve support normal travel within plus/minus20mm at1mm clearance, then reject translations longer than25mm
Re-solve left arm for each feasible anchor and measure raw pad distance, normal opposition, all hand/gun and left inter-finger crossings, body/arms and invariants

At most one diagnostic proposal may be retained: no sampled hand/body/arm/inter-finger crossings, at least two fingers each improve at least one proximal/middle minimum by2mm, no proximal/middle minimum worsens by more than1mm, and actual palm clearance remains within tolerance

Improving minima must face an actual handguard-region triangle (weapon-local centroid X[-.07,.07],Y[.035,.17],Z[-.46,-.17] metres) with opposing normals; preserve nearest face/point evidence for independent visual review
Root and independent visual review remain required; an improved proposal is not an accepted complete grip or a runtime asset
Vertex-ray support is a bounded proposal only, not a whole-palm contact or containment proof; no valid anchor found is not a global infeasibility proof
